title: Specified projections for the chosen Hom-complex
statement: For any category, topology and commutative ring sheaf with the required composition instance, the chosen Hom-complex bifunctor admits product-limit projections satisfying the defining differential and chain-map formulas.

source.place: Section 0A8X, the Hom-complex construction; evaluation-at-one reduction

proof.text:
apply `Classical.choose_spec` to `homComplex_exists`; its chosen first
component is precisely `homComplexFunctor`. This exposes the projection
specification without repeatedly reducing the large bifunctor existence type.

lean.statement: theorem homComplex_projections_exists : let F := homComplexFunctor.{u, v, w, r} (C := C) (J := J) (R := R); ∃ π : ∀ (L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{w} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (n p q : ℤ), p + n = q → (((F.obj (op L)).obj M).X n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (L.X p) (M.X q)), (∀ (L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{w} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (n : ℤ), Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk (((F.obj (op L)).obj M).X n) (fun p : ℤ ↦ π L M n p (p + n) rfl)))) ∧ (∀ (L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{w} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (n m p q q' p' : ℤ) (_hnm : n + 1 = m) (hpq : p + m = q) (hq' : p + n = q') (hp' : p' + n = q), ((F.obj (op L)).obj M).d n m ≫ π L M m p q hpq = π L M n p q' hq' ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (𝟙 (L.X p)) (M.d q' q) - n.negOnePow • (π L M n p' q hp' ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (L.d p p') (𝟙 (M.X q)))) ∧ (∀ (L L' M M' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{w} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (f : L' ⟶ L) (g : M ⟶ M') (n p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q), (((F.map f.op).app M) ≫ (F.obj (op L')).map g).f n ≫ π L' M' n p q hpq = π L M n p q hpq ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (f.f p) (g.f q))
